description: Tool to create a new custom theme in Typeform with colors, fonts, background, and layout settings. Use when you need to create a theme for branding and styling Typeform forms.

brightness.description: Background brightness level, must be between -1 and 1
brightness.title: Brightness

layout.description: Background image layout. Must be 'fullscreen', 'repeat', or 'no-repeat'
layout.title: Layout

colors.description: Color configuration with answer, background, button, and question hex values. All color fields are required.

answer.description: Hex color code for answer text (e.g., '#4FB0AE')
answer.title: Answer

question.description: Hex color code for question text (e.g., '#3D3D3D')
question.title: Question

colors.title: Colors

fields.description: Field alignment (left/center) and font_size (small/medium/large). Both fields are required.

alignment.description: Text alignment for form fields. Must be 'left' or 'center'
alignment.title: Alignment

font_size.description: Font size for form fields. Must be 'small', 'medium', or 'large'
font_size.title: Font Size

fields.title: Fields

font.description: Font choice from predefined Typeform options (e.g., 'Karla', 'Arial', 'Georgia'). This field is required by the API.
font.title: Font

has_transparent_button.description: Whether the button should be transparent
has_transparent_button.title: Has Transparent Button

rounded_corners.description: Border radius setting. Must be 'none', 'small', or 'large'
rounded_corners.title: Rounded Corners
